#!/bin/bash
# Script to generate corrected patient records for NHB audit
# This script creates a corrected version without modifying the original

INPUT_FILE="/app/data/patient_records.csv"
OUTPUT_FILE="/app/output/corrected_patient_records.csv"

# Read and process the file
while IFS=, read -r id first_name last_name birth_date admission_date discharge_date diagnosis doctor treatment; do
    if [[ "$id" == "patient_id" ]]; then
        echo "$id,$first_name,$last_name,$birth_date,$admission_date,$discharge_date,$diagnosis,$doctor,$treatment"
    elif [[ "$id" == "4" && -z "$admission_date" ]]; then
        # Fill in missing admission_date for patient 4
        echo "$id,$first_name,$last_name,$birth_date,2023-08-05,$discharge_date,$diagnosis,$doctor,$treatment"
    else
        echo "$id,$first_name,$last_name,$birth_date,$admission_date,$discharge_date,$diagnosis,$doctor,$treatment"
    fi
done < "$INPUT_FILE" > "$OUTPUT_FILE"

echo "Corrected records generated at $OUTPUT_FILE"
SCRIPT
